Core ML/AI Libraries import gradio as gr import numpy as np import requests from transformers import pipeline from PIL import Image import torch # FastAPI for RESTful APIs from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, BackgroundTasks, Request from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse, StreamingResponse from fastapi.security import HTTPBearer, HTTPAuthorizationCredentials import uvicorn # Configure logging logging.basicConfig( level=logging.INFO, format='%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s', handlers=[ logging.FileHandler('logs/oasis_v3.log'), logging.StreamHandler() ] ) logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) # Initialize FastAPI app app = FastAPI( title="OASIS v3 - AI Superintelligence API", description="Ultra-Lightweight AI Processing Engine with Revenue Generation", version="3.0.0", docs_url="/docs", redoc_url="/redoc" ) # CORS middleware for cross-origin requests app.add_middleware( CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=["*"], allow_credentials=True, allow_methods=["*"], allow_headers=["*"], ) @dataclass class OASISResponse: """Standardized response format for all OASIS operations""" success: bool data: Any message: str = "" timestamp: str = "" processing_time: float = 0.0 revenue_generated: float = 0.0 def __post_init__(self): if not self.timestamp: self.timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() class OASISCore: """Core OASIS v3 Engine - Multi-Modal AI Processing""" def __init__(self): self.version = "3.0.0" self.startup_time = datetime.now(timezone.utc) self.total_requests = 0 self.total_revenue = 0.0 self.active_sessions = {} # Initialize AI pipelines self._initialize_ai_models() # Revenue tracking self.pricing = { "text_generation": 0.05, # $0.05 per request "image_analysis": 0.08, # $0.08 per request "audio_processing": 0.12, # $0.12 per request "video_analysis": 0.20, # $0.20 per request "custom_model": 0.15, # $0.15 per request "batch_processing": 0.03 # $0.03 per item } logger.info(f"🚀 OASIS v3 Core Engine initialized successfully") def _initialize_ai_models(self): """Initialize AI model pipelines with lazy loading for performance""" self.models = {} # Text Processing Models self.text_models = { "sentiment": "cardiffnlp/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-latest", "generation": "gpt2-medium", "summarization": "facebook/bart-large-cnn", "translation": "Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-fr", "question_answering": "deepset/roberta-base-squad2", "text_classification": "microsoft/DialoGPT-medium" } # Image Processing Models self.image_models = { "classification": "google/vit-base-patch16-224", "object_detection": "facebook/detr-resnet-50", "image_captioning": "nlpconnect/vit-gpt2-image-captioning", "style_transfer": "runwayml/stable-diffusion-v1-5" } # Audio Processing Models self.audio_models = { "speech_to_text": "openai/whisper-base", "text_to_speech": "microsoft/speecht5_tts", "audio_classification": "MIT/ast-finetuned-audioset-10-10-0.4593" } logger.info(f"📚 Loaded {len(self.text_models + self.image_models + self.audio_models)} AI model configurations") async def process_text(self, text: str, task: str = "generation", **kwargs) -> OASISResponse: """Process text using specified AI model""" start_time = time.time() try: if task not in self.text_models: return OASISResponse( success=False, data={}, message=f"Unknown text task: {task}" ) # Lazy load model pipeline if task not in self.models: model_name = self.text_models[task] self.models[task] = pipeline(task.replace("_", "-"), model=model_name) logger.info(f"🔄 Loaded {task} model: {model_name}") # Process text result = self.models[task](text, **kwargs) # Calculate processing metrics processing_time = time.time() - start_time revenue = self.pricing.get("text_generation", 0.05) self.total_revenue += revenue self.total_requests += 1 return OASISResponse( success=True, data=result, message=f"Text {task} completed successfully", processing_time=processing_time, revenue_generated=revenue ) except Exception as e: logger.error(f"❌ Text processing error: {str(e)}") return OASISResponse( success=False, data={}, message=f"Text processing failed: {str(e)}", processing_time=time.time() - start_time ) async def process_image(self, image_data: Any, task: str = "classification", **kwargs) -> OASISResponse: """Process image using specified AI model""" start_time = time.time() try: if task not in self.image_models: return OASISResponse( success=False, data={}, message=f"Unknown image task: {task}" ) # Lazy load model pipeline if f"image_{task}" not in self.models: model_name = self.image_models[task] if task == "classification": self.models[f"image_{task}"] = pipeline("image-classification", model=model_name) elif task == "object_detection": self.models[f"image_{task}"] = pipeline("object-detection", model=model_name) elif task == "image_captioning": self.models[f"image_{task}"] = pipeline("image-to-text", model=model_name) logger.info(f"🖼️ Loaded image {task} model: {model_name}") # Download image from URL response = requests.get(image_url) image = Image.open(io.BytesIO(response.content)) result = await oasis.process_image(image, task, **kwargs) return asdict(result) except Exception as e: raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Image processing failed: {str(e)}") @app.get("/api/v3/models/available") async def get_available_models(): """Get list of all available AI models""" return { "text_models": oasis.text_models, "image_models": oasis.image_models, "audio_models": oasis.audio_models, "total_models": len(oasis.text_models) + len(oasis.image_models) + len(oasis.audio_models) } @app.post("/api/v3/revenue/track") async def track_revenue(request: Dict): """Track revenue from external integrations""" service = request.get("service", "custom") amount = float(request.get("amount", 0)) oasis.total_revenue += amount return { "success": True, "service": service, "amount": amount, "total_revenue": oasis.total_revenue, "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() } # Gradio Interface for Web UI def create_gradio_interface(): """Create responsive Gradio interface for OASIS v3""" # Custom CSS for mobile-first design custom_css = """ .gradio-container { max-width: 1200px !important; margin: 0 auto !important; } .gr-button { background: linear-gradient(45deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%) !important; border: none !important; color: white !important; font-weight: bold !important; } .gr-input, .gr-textbox { border-radius: 10px !important; border: 2px solid #e1e5e9 !important; } .header-text { text-align: center; color: #2d3748; margin: 20px 0; } @media (max-width: 768px) { .gradio-container { padding: 10px !important; } } """ # import json

class TextProcessRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=10000, description="Text to process")
    task: str = Field(default="generation", description="AI task to perform")
    params: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="Additional parameters")

    image_url: str = Field(..., description="URL of image to process")
    task: str = Field(default="classification", description="Image processing task")

    items: List[Dict[str, Any]] = Field(..., min_items=1, max_items=100)
    task_type: str = Field(..., description="Type of processing (text, image, audio)")
    batch_params: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)

class OASISAPIResponse(BaseModel):
    success: bool
    data: Any
    message: str = ""
    timestamp: str = ""
    processing_time: float = 0.0
    revenue_generated: float = 0.0
    request_id: str = ""

# Create API router
router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v3", tags=["OASIS v3 API"])

class TermuxOptimizedAPI:
    """API endpoints optimized for Termux orchestration"""
    
    def __init__(self, oasis_core):
        self.oasis = oasis_core
        self.mobile_cache = {}  # Simple in-memory cache for mobile optimization
        
    async def _generate_request_id(self) -> str:
        """Generate unique request ID for tracking"""
        import uuid
        return str(uuid.uuid4())[:8]
    
    async def _optimize_for_mobile(self, data: Any, compress: bool = True) -> Any:
        """Optimize response for mobile consumption"""
        if compress and isinstance(data, (dict, list)):
            # Remove verbose fields for mobile
            if isinstance(data, dict):
                # Keep only essential fields
                mobile_data = {}
                essential_fields = ['result', 'score', 'label', 'text', 'summary']
                for field in essential_fields:
                    if field in data:
                        mobile_data[field] = data[field]
                return mobile_data if mobile_data else data
        return data

# Termux-Optimized Endpoints

@router.post("/termux/text", response_model=OASISAPIResponse)
async def termux_process_text(
    request: TextProcessRequest,
    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks,
    compress: bool = True
):
    """
    Termux-optimized text processing endpoint
    Minimal payload, maximum efficiency
    """
    start_time = time.time()
    request_id = await TermuxOptimizedAPI(None)._generate_request_id()
    
    try:
        # Get OASIS instance from app state
        from app import oasis
        
        result = await oasis.process_text(request.text, request.task, **request.params)
        
        # Optimize response for mobile
        api = TermuxOptimizedAPI(oasis)
        optimized_data = await api._optimize_for_mobile(result.data, compress)
        
        # Background task for analytics
        background_tasks.add_task(log_mobile_request, request_id, "text", result.processing_time)
        
        return OASISAPIResponse(
            success=result.success,
            data=optimized_data,
            message=result.message,
            timestamp=result.timestamp,
            processing_time=result.processing_time,
            revenue_generated=result.revenue_generated,
            request_id=request_id
        )
        
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Termux text processing error: {str(e)}")
        return OASISAPIResponse(
            success=False,
            data={},
            message=f"Processing failed: {str(e)}",
            processing_time=time.time() - start_time,
            request_id=request_id
        )

@router.post("/termux/batch", response_model=OASISAPIResponse)
async def termux_batch_process(
    request: BatchProcessRequest,
    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks
):
    """
    Batch processing optimized for Termux
    Process multiple items efficiently
    """
    start_time = time.time()
    request_id = await TermuxOptimizedAPI(None)._generate_request_id()
    
    try:
        from app import oasis
        
        results = []
        total_revenue = 0.0
        
        for item in request.items:
            if request.task_type == "text":
                result = await oasis.process_text(
                    item.get("text", ""), 
                    item.get("task", "generation"),
                    **request.batch_params
                )
            elif request.task_type == "image":
                # Handle image processing
                result = await oasis.process_image(
                    item.get("image_url", ""),
                    item.get("task", "classification"),
                    **request.batch_params
                )
            else:
                continue
                
            results.append({
                "item_id": item.get("id", len(results)),
                "success": result.success,
                "data": result.data,
                "processing_time": result.processing_time
            })
            total_revenue += result.revenue_generated
        
        # Background analytics
        background_tasks.add_task(
            log_batch_request, 
            request_id, 
            request.task_type, 
            len(request.items)
        )
        
        return OASISAPIResponse(
            success=True,
            data={"results": results, "processed_count": len(results)},
            message=f"Batch processing completed: {len(results)} items",
            processing_time=time.time() - start_time,
            revenue_generated=total_revenue,
            request_id=request_id
        )
        
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Batch processing error: {str(e)}")
        return OASISAPIResponse(
            success=False,
            data={},
            message=f"Batch processing failed: {str(e)}",
            processing_time=time.time() - start_time,
            request_id=request_id
        )

# STEP 2: CREATE TERMUX ORCHESTRATOR - Ultra-Lightweight Command Center
# CRITICAL: Only Python stdlib + urllib (NO external dependencies)

termux_orchestrator_content = '''#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
OASIS v3 - Termux Ultra-Lightweight Orchestrator
Revolutionary Mobile AI Command Center

STRICT REQUIREMENTS:
- ZERO external dependencies 
- Uses ONLY Python standard library + urllib
- Total footprint < 5MB
- Maximum compatibility dengan Termux environment
- API-first communication dengan HuggingFace Spaces

Author: OASIS Development Team  
License: MIT
Version: 3.0.0-termux-minimal
"""

import json
import time
import sys
import os
import platform
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional
import urllib.request
import urllib.parse
import urllib.error
import subprocess
import hashlib
import base64
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import logging

# Configure minimal logging
logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format='%(asctime)s - OASIS - %(message)s',
    handlers=[logging.StreamHandler()]
)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class OASISTermuxOrchestrator:
    """
    OASIS v3 Ultra-Lightweight Termux Orchestrator
    
    Revolutionary mobile AI command center dengan:
    - ZERO external dependencies
    - Pure Python standard library
    - <5MB total footprint
    - Ultra-fast response times
    - Revenue generation tracking
    """
    
    def __init__(self, hf_space_url: str = None, config_file: str = "oasis_config.json"):
        """Initialize orchestrator dengan minimal setup"""
        
        self.version = "3.0.0-termux"
        self.startup_time = datetime.now()
        self.hf_space_url = hf_space_url or "https://your-username-oasis-v3.hf.space"
        
        # Load configuration
        self.config = self._load_config(config_file)
        
        # Session tracking
        self.session_id = str(uuid.uuid4())[:8]
        self.request_count = 0
        self.total_revenue = 0.0
        self.errors = 0
        
        # Mobile optimization settings
        self.timeout = 30
        self.max_retries = 3
        self.compress_requests = True
        
        logger.info(f"🚀 OASIS Termux Orchestrator v{self.version} initialized")
        logger.info(f"📱 Session ID: {self.session_id}")
        logger.info(f"🌐 HF Space: {self.hf_space_url}")
    
    def _load_config(self, config_file: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Load configuration file atau create default"""
        try:
            if os.path.exists(config_file):
                with open(config_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                    return json.load(f)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Config load failed: {e}, using defaults")
        
        # Default configuration
        default_config = {
            "hf_space_url": self.hf_space_url,
            "timeout": 30,
            "max_retries": 3,
            "compress_responses": True,
            "revenue_tracking": True,
            "pricing": {
                "text_generation": 0.05,
                "image_analysis": 0.08,
                "audio_processing": 0.12,
                "batch_processing": 0.03
            }
        }
        
        # Save default config
        try:
            with open(config_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                json.dump(default_config, f, indent=2)
            logger.info(f"📄 Created default config: {config_file}")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to save config: {e}")
        
        return default_config
    
    def _make_request(self, endpoint: str, data: Dict[str, Any] = None, method: str = "GET") -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Make HTTP request menggunakan urllib (NO external dependencies)"""
        
        url = f"{self.hf_space_url.rstrip('/')}/{endpoint.lstrip('/')}"
        
        try:
            # Prepare request data
            if data and method == "POST":
                json_data = json.dumps(data).encode('utf-8')
                req = urllib.request.Request(
                    url,
                    data=json_data,
                    headers={
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'User-Agent': f'OASIS-Termux/{self.version}',
                        'Accept': 'application/json'
                    },
                    method=method
                )
            else:
                req = urllib.request.Request(
                    url,
                    headers={
                        'User-Agent': f'OASIS-Termux/{self.version}',
                        'Accept': 'application/json'
                    }
                )
            
            # Execute request dengan retry logic
            for attempt in range(self.max_retries):
                try:
                    start_time = time.time()
                    
                    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=self.timeout) as response:
                        response_time = time.time() - start_time
                        
                        if response.status == 200:
                            content = response.read().decode('utf-8')
                            result = json.loads(content)
                            
                            # Track metrics
                            self.request_count += 1
                            
                            logger.info(f"✅ {method} {endpoint} - {response_time:.3f}s")
                            
                            return {
                                "success": True,
                                "data": result,
                                "response_time": response_time,
                                "attempt": attempt + 1
                            }
                        else:
                            logger.warning(f"❌ HTTP {response.status} - {endpoint}")
                            
                except urllib.error.URLError as e:
                    if attempt < self.max_retries - 1:
                        wait_time = (2 ** attempt)
                        logger.warning(f"⏳ Retry {attempt + 1}/{self.max_retries} in {wait_time}s...")
                        time.sleep(wait_time)
                    else:
                        logger.error(f"❌ Request failed after {self.max_retries} attempts: {e}")
                        self.errors += 1
                        
                        return {
                            "success": False,
                            "error": str(e),
                            "endpoint": endpoint,
                            "attempts": self.max_retries
                        }
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ Request error: {str(e)}")
            self.errors += 1
            return {
                "success": False,
                "error": str(e),
                "endpoint": endpoint
            }
    
    def health_check(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Check OASIS HF Space health"""
        logger.info("🏥 Checking OASIS health...")
        return self._make_request("api/v3/termux/health")
    
    def get_system_status(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get comprehensive system status"""
        logger.info("📊 Getting system status...")
        return self._make_request("api/v3/termux/status")
    
    def get_available_models(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get list of available AI models"""
        logger.info("🧠 Fetching available models...")
        return self._make_request("api/v3/termux/models")
    
    def process_text(self, text: str, task: str = "generation", **kwargs) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Process text menggunakan HF Space AI models"""
        logger.info(f"📝 Processing text: {task}")
        
        payload = {
            "text": text,
            "task": task,
            "params": kwargs
        }
        
        result = self._make_request("api/v3/termux/text", data=payload, method="POST")
        
        # Track revenue
        if result.get("success") and "data" in result:
            response_data = result["data"]
            if "revenue_generated" in response_data:
                self.total_revenue += response_data["revenue_generated"]
        
        return result
    
    def batch_process(self, items: List[Dict[str, Any]], task_type: str = "text", **batch_params) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Batch process multiple items efficiently"""
        logger.info(f"⚡ Batch processing {len(items)} items - {task_type}")
        
        payload = {
            "items": items,
            "task_type": task_type,
            "batch_params": batch_params
        }
        
        result = self._make_request("api/v3/termux/batch", data=payload, method="POST")
        
        # Track batch revenue
        if result.get("success") and "data" in result:
            response_data = result["data"] 
            if "revenue_generated" in response_data:
                self.total_revenue += response_data["revenue_generated"]
        
        return result
    
    def get_session_stats(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get current session statistics"""
        uptime = datetime.now() - self.startup_time
        
        return {
            "session_id": self.session_id,
            "version": self.version,
            "uptime_seconds": uptime.total_seconds(),
            "uptime_human": str(uptime).split('.')[0],
            "requests_made": self.request_count,
            "errors": self.errors,
            "success_rate": (self.request_count - self.errors) / max(self.request_count, 1) * 100,
            "total_revenue": round(self.total_revenue, 4),
            "hf_space_url": self.hf_space_url,
            "mobile_optimized": True,
            "dependencies": "ZERO (stdlib only)",
            "footprint": "<5MB",
            "platform": platform.platform(),
            "python_version": platform.python_version(),
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
        }
    
    def run_interactive_mode(self):
        """Run interactive command-line interface"""
        
        print(f"""
🎯 OASIS v3 Termux Orchestrator - Interactive Mode
================================================
Version: {self.version}
Session: {self.session_id}
HF Space: {self.hf_space_url}

Available Commands:
  1. health     - Check system health
  2. status     - Get system status  
  3. models     - List available models
  4. text       - Process text
  5. batch      - Batch processing
  6. stats      - Session statistics
  7. config     - Show configuration
  8. quit       - Exit orchestrator

🚀 Type command atau number to continue...
        """)
        
        while True:
            try:
                cmd = input("\\n🤖 OASIS> ").strip().lower()
                
                if cmd in ['quit', 'exit', '8']:
                    print("👋 OASIS Orchestrator shutting down...")
                    break
                    
                elif cmd in ['health', '1']:
                    result = self.health_check()
                    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
                    
                elif cmd in ['status', '2']:
                    result = self.get_system_status()
                    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
                    
                elif cmd in ['models', '3']:
                    result = self.get_available_models()
                    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
                    
                elif cmd in ['text', '4']:
                    text = input("Enter text: ")
                    task = input("Task (generation/sentiment/summarization): ") or "generation"
                    result = self.process_text(text, task)
                    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
                    
                elif cmd in ['batch', '5']:
                    print("Batch processing mode - implement based on needs")
                    
                elif cmd in ['stats', '6']:
                    stats = self.get_session_stats()
                    print(json.dumps(stats, indent=2))
                    
                elif cmd in ['config', '7']:
                    print(json.dumps(self.config, indent=2))
                    
                else:
                    print("❓ Unknown command. Type 'quit' to exit.")
                    
            except KeyboardInterrupt:
                print("\\n👋 OASIS Orchestrator interrupted by user")
                break
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Interactive mode error: {str(e)}")
                print(f"❌ Error: {str(e)}")

def main():

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="OASIS v3 Termux Orchestrator - Ultra-Lightweight AI Command Center"
    )
    parser.add_argument(

# Create GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline
github_workflow = '''name: OASIS v3 CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

env:
  NODE_VERSION: '18.x'
  
jobs:
  # Code Quality & Testing
  quality-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Quality Check & Testing
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
        
      - name: Type checking
        run: npm run type-check
        
      - name: Lint code
        run: npm run lint
        
      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test
        
      - name: Build application
        run: npm run build
        
      - name: Bundle analysis
        run: npm run analyze
        
  # Security Scanning
  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Security Scan
    needs: quality-check
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Run security audit
        run: npm audit --audit-level high
        
      - name: Scan dependencies
        uses: securecodewarrior/github-action-add-sarif@v1
        with:
          sarif-file: security-scan.sarif
          
  # Performance Testing
  performance-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Performance Test
    needs: quality-check
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
        
      - name: Build for production
        run: npm run build
        
      - name: Lighthouse CI
        uses: treosh/lighthouse-ci-action@v10
        with:
          configPath: '.lighthouserc.json'
          uploadArtifacts: true
          
  # Mobile Testing
  mobile-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Mobile Compatibility Test
    needs: quality-check
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
        
      - name: Build application
        run: npm run build
        
      - name: Mobile viewport testing
        run: |
          npm install -g puppeteer
          node scripts/mobile-test.js
          
  # Deploy to Vercel (Production)
  deploy-production:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Deploy to Production
    needs: [security-scan, performance-test, mobile-test]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Deploy to Vercel
        uses: amondnet/vercel-action@v25
        with:
          vercel-token: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
          vercel-org-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
          vercel-project-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID }}
          vercel-args: '--prod'
          
      - name: Update deployment status
        run: |
          echo "✅ OASIS v3 Frontend deployed successfully"
          echo "🚀 Production URL: https://oasis-v3.vercel.app"
          
  # Deploy to Staging
  deploy-staging:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Deploy to Staging
    needs: [security-scan, performance-test, mobile-test]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop' && github.event_name == 'push'
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Deploy to Vercel (Preview)
        uses: amondnet/vercel-action@v25
        with:
          vercel-token: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
          vercel-org-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
          vercel-project-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID }}
          
      - name: Update staging status
        run: |
          echo "✅ OASIS v3 Frontend staging deployed"
          echo "🔍 Preview URL available in Vercel dashboard"
'''

frontend_readme = '''# OASIS v3 Frontend

> 🚀 **Revolutionary Mobile-First AI Superintelligence Interface**

Zero-cost, mobile-optimized frontend for the OASIS v3 ecosystem, powered by Next.js and designed for seamless integration with Hugging Face Spaces and Termux orchestration.

## 🎯 Project Overview

**OASIS v3 Frontend** is the user interface component of the Open Source AI Superintelligence ecosystem, featuring:

- **📱 Mobile-First Design**: Optimized for Android/Termux environments
- **🤖 Multi-Modal AI Processing**: Text, image, audio, and multimodal capabilities
- **💰 Revenue Tracking**: Built-in analytics for $500-20K/month business model
- **⚡ Ultra-Performance**: Optimized for low-bandwidth, mobile networks
- **🔗 Seamless Integration**: Direct connection to HF Spaces and Termux orchestrator

## 🏗️ Architecture

```
┌─────────────────┐    ┌──────────────────┐    ┌─────────────────┐
│   Next.js App   │◄──►│  HF Spaces API   │◄──►│  100,000+ Models │

└─────────────────┘    └──────────────────┘    └─────────────────┘
```

- Glass morphism effects and smooth animations
- Dark mode and high contrast support

### 🧠 **AI Processing Capabilities**

- Model performance metrics and optimization insights
- Cost per request analysis and profit margins

- Mobile network optimization

- Node.js 18+ 
- npm or yarn package manager
- Git for version control

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/oasis-team/oasis-v3-frontend.git

   ```

   ```bash
   npm install
   # or
   yarn install
   ```

3. **Environment setup**
   ```bash
   cp .env.example .env.local

   ```

4. **Start development server**
   ```bash
   npm run dev

   yarn dev
   ```
